431  def maintenance_check(output: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
   432      output = output.resolve()
   433      if not (output / "state.json").is_file():
   434          raise CkbError(f"CKB output is required: {output}")
   435      from .agent_index import audit_agent_index
   436      from .agent_protocol import audit_agent_protocol
   437      from .knowledge_layers import audit_human_layer
   438      from .keyword_fallback import audit_keyword_fallback
   439      from .machine_knowledge import audit_machine_knowledge
   440      from .operation_journal import audit_operation_journal
   441      from .research_gaps import audit_gap_register
   442      from .reference_documents import audit_references
   443      from .work_record_index import audit_work_record_index
   444  
   445      checks = {
   446          "agent_protocol": audit_agent_protocol(output),
   447          "work_record_index": audit_work_record_index(output),
   448          "agent_index": audit_agent_index(output),
   449          "machine_knowledge": audit_machine_knowledge(output),
   450          "keyword_fallback": audit_keyword_fallback(output),
   451          "human_layer": audit_human_layer(output),
   452          "references": audit_references(output),
   453          "operations": audit_operation_journal(output),
   454          "research_gaps": audit_gap_register(output),
   455      }
   456      failed = [name for name, result in checks.items() if result.get("status") != "passed"]
   457      readability_path = output / "human/readability-audit.json"
   458      readability = json_load(readability_path) if readability_path.is_file() else {"status": "missing"}
   459      if readability.get("status") != "passed":
   460          failed.append("human_readability")
   461      report = {
   462          "schema_version": 1,
   463          "status": "passed" if not failed else "failed",
   464          "checked_at_utc": utc_now(),
   465          "output": str(output),
   466          "page_writes": 0,
   467          "checks": checks,
   468          "human_readability": {
   469              "status": readability.get("status"),
   470              "path": str(readability_path.resolve()),
   471              "errors": readability.get("errors", []),
   472          },
   473          "capability_counts": capability_matrix()["counts"],
   474          "failed_checks": failed,
   475      }
   476      target = output / "workspace-meta/maintenance/latest.json"
   477      json_write(target, report)
   478      reopened = json_load(target)
   479      if reopened.get("status") != report["status"] or reopened.get("failed_checks") != failed:
   480          raise CkbError("maintenance report did not reopen with the verified state")
   481      return {**report, "report": str(target.resolve())}
